【動画編集もClaudeで自動化】

Fable 5によって働き方がどの程度変わったのかを紹介した動画、
やはりFable 5によって最初から最後まで編集されていました。
これを無制限で使えるAnthropic社員が羨ましい！

以下が詳細です↓

人間がやったのは、17テイク・25GBの撮影素材が入ったフォルダを渡しただけ。
どの動画がどのシーンに対応するかすら教えていない。

そこから Fable 5 がやったこと：
・Whisper で全テイクを文字起こし
・「えーと」が少ないベストテイクをシーンごとに自動選別
・採用クリップと開始/終了時刻をまとめた編集用JSONを生成
・FFmpeg で結合
・カラーグレーディングのコードを自分で書いて適用
・Remotion で字幕やUIをビートに合わせて合成
・Figma MCP でデザインチームの修正を動画へ反映
・npx remotion render で最終レンダリング

編集ソフトもタイムラインも一切触らず、全部「コード」で完結しています。
動画編集がエンジニアリングのタスクになっています。

title: Fable 5 benchmark results compared with other models
author: lagerskoy
verification: Fetched from X via twitter-cli from global-search; original author and post URL preserved.
note: Original post did not expose a complete repeatable prompt. Treat this as a real showcase post, not a verified tutorial.
originalText:
CLAUDE FABLE 5 IS PLAYING A DIFFERENT GAME

Same prompts, same tasks, same rules, yet the outputs don't even feel like they came from the same generation of AI. While other models produced decent simulations, Claude Fable 5 generated scenes that look closer to finished products than experiments. The fluid simulation has more depth, the lunar environment feels like an actual game world, and the black hole render looks like something pulled from a modern visualization engine rather than a chatbot response.

What's interesting isn't that one model won a benchmark. It's that the gap is becoming visible without charts, scores, or leaderboards. You can see it instantly. When people can identify the stronger model from a few seconds of video, the conversation shifts from "which AI is best" to "how far ahead is it"

The most dangerous thing about AI progress is that it happens gradually, then all at once. This video feels a lot like one of those moments.
summary: Shares updated coding-agent benchmark results and positions Claude Fable 5 against other frontier coding agents.

A 152 NODE FABLE 5 LATTICE FIRED 552 EDGES IN ONE PROMPT. THE SAME WORKFLOW UNDERCUTS $8,000 GAMING STUDIOS FOR $20

gamification agencies sell custom browser mini-games to brands at $3,000 to $8,000 per project. marketing teams buy them because an interactive thing holds attention longer than any banner

one builder typed a prompt chain into fable 5 and got back a gta-style open world game. driving, shooting, gang ai, cop chases, radar minimap. one html file, no engine, no assets

the trick is one feature per message. skeleton first, then on-foot mode, then combat, then polish. every step stays playable and nothing breaks under the previous layer

shipping takes a minute. drag the html file onto netlify drop, get a public link. no backend, no database, three.js loads from a cdn for free

the real product is the proof. a working interactive demo lands a client at $500 to $2,500 per reskin and agencies that quote $8,000 cannot move that fast
